description: Servo drive with Modbus RTU: monitoring, control modes, I/O, regulation, motor, positioning, serial, network, ladder and user parameters
source: WEG SCA06 programming manual 10002087836 / 03, software V2.1X
notes: Every parameter Pxxxx is the holding register of the same number (P0003 is register 3). Functions 03, 06 and 16.
Values travel as integers: a parameter shown as 1.5 A is sent as 15. Scales follow the decimal places of the parameter table of the programming manual.
Parameters with several ranges, hexadecimal words or values that do not fit one register are shown raw, with the documented values in the description.

The RS-485 interface is an accessory; its address is P0656, its speed P0658 and its format P0659. P0660 = 2 selects Modbus (factory). Factory: address 1, 9600 bit/s; the format code 3 is 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits.
Parameters that need an accessory module answer only when it is fitted.
Written from the manufacturer's programming manual; not tested on a device.
